/**
 * Product
 * Built by FlowCode from the app model; it reads and writes the app's store and look-up layer (src/app/).
 */
import { LookupEntry } from "../sections/LookupEntry";
import { useHashId } from "../sections/AppData";
import { go } from "../app/routes";
import { lookup } from "../app/lookup";

export default function ProductScreen() {
  const id = useHashId("product") ?? "";
  return (
    <LookupEntry
      lookup={lookup}
      id={id}
      shareScreen={"product"}
      onBack={() => go("catalog")}
      onOpenPlace={() => go("places")}
      onOpenList={(list) => go("list", list)}
    />
  );
}
